# Place and safety brief

## Place definition

Official name, full address/administrative boundary, coordinates, source identifier, population denominator, and comparison locations.

## Safety evidence

Separate recorded crime, disasters, infrastructure hazards, travel guidance, and perception. Never collapse them into one opaque score.

## Metrics

| Measure | Count | Population-normalized rate | Period | Coverage | Source |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|

## Limitations

Reporting practices, participation, approximate locations, missing jurisdictions, revisions, and reasons comparisons may be invalid.
